description: Replace the graph schema with a new full definition; use to bootstrap an empty graph (cold-start) or fully replace mid-build. STRUCTURAL RULES (load-bearing): (1) HIERARCHICAL with a single root - exactly ONE type has no parent; every other type MUST declare a parent. (2) Each parent / required / suggested connection is XOR: ONE concrete target_node OR polymorphic=true - never both, never a list of multiple targets. (3) DEFAULT TO CONCRETE target_node. Polymorphic is the ESCAPE HATCH - reserve for genuinely cross-cutting concepts like Comment or Tag (entities that validly attach to many distinct types). If you find yourself making most parents polymorphic, you are avoiding the design work - pick concrete relationships instead. If you can't pick a concrete parent, you may be missing a type - add the missing type first. (4) Same-type nesting is implicit: a node can be placed under another of its same type using the existing parent relation - never add a self-relation just to enable nesting. (5) Give every type, attribute and select value you add or rewrite a `description` in the shape its parameter states; stored descriptions you send back unchanged are kept as they are. When replacing mid-build, call naumu_get_schema first (it returns a round-trippable structural schema you can copy back) and send the FULL new schema; anything you omit is removed. PARENT PRESERVATION: omitting a type's `connections.parent` PRESERVES its existing parent (so a round-trip never silently orphans a type). To intentionally remove a parent and make a type a root, send `parent: null` explicitly. (A parent whose target type you delete is dropped automatically.) Conventions: type names PascalCase, relation names UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Bias toward general types - refine via attributes or nested children, not type proliferation.

description.description: Schema-level description / domain summary. Omit to keep the current space-wide description; send an empty string to clear it. Max 4,000 chars.

nodes.description: All node types in the schema.

attributes.description: Type-level attributes for instances of this type.

description.description: Required on a new attribute. One clause, at most 15 words, in the space's language: what the value tells you and when it is set.

multiple.description: person only - allow several people. The node value becomes a list of people (write it as an array or a comma-separated list of names/emails).

requiredOnWrite.description: True when every write that creates or updates a node of this type must also set this attribute.

type.description: Attribute type (required). select/multiselect define a closed set of categories with values; string/number/boolean/date/person hold per-node data with values []. Calendar dates use "date", not select values. "person" references one space member (owner, assignee), or several when `multiple` is true.

values.description: Allowed enum values for select/multiselect; pass [] for every other type.

description.description: Required on a new select value. One phrase, at most 10 words, in the space's language: the condition that picks it over the other values.

label.description: Display label for this enum value

color.description: Optional hex color for instances of this type.

parent.description: Optional parent relation (this type nests under another via this connection).

polymorphic.description: Set true when this relation can target multiple types.

relation.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE relation name (e.g. WORKS_AT, BUILT_BY, BELONGS_TO)

target_node.description: Target type name. Omit when polymorphic=true.

required.description: Required outgoing connections to other types.

defaultVisibility.description: Default visibility for NEW nodes of this type when no explicit visibility is passed on creation. Does NOT retroactively change visibility on existing nodes. "open" = visible to anyone with the space link (including non-members), "internal" = visible to all space members, "restricted" = only members explicitly granted access. Omit to leave the type unset - it then falls back to the space-level defaultVisibility.

description.description: Required on a new type. One sentence pair, at most 25 words, in the space's language: "A [what], used when [scope]. Not [nearest sibling]; that is [other type]."

type.description: Type name in PascalCase (e.g. TypeA, TypeB)

name: naumu_update_schema
title: Update Graph Schema
